arXiv:2604.07191v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 4 月 8 日arXiv:2604.07191v1 [cs.LG] 08 Apr 2026
 

混合物比例估计和条件独立性的弱监督核测试Mixture Proportion Estimation and Weakly-supervised Kernel Test for Conditional Independence

 

广濑勇士Yushi Hirose          楢原明人Akito Narahara          金森贵文Takafumi Kanamori

东京科学研究所Institute of Science Tokyo          东京科学研究所Institute of Science Tokyo          东京科学研究所、RIKEN AIPInstitute of Science Tokyo, RIKEN AIP

摘要Abstract

混合比例估计（MPE）旨在根据未标记的数据估计类先验。该任务是弱监督学习（例如 PU 学习、标签噪声学习和领域适应）中的关键组成部分。现有的 MPE 方法依赖于Mixture proportion estimation (MPE) aims to estimate class priors from unlabeled data. This task is a critical component in weakly supervised learning, such as PU learning, learning with label noise, and domain adaptation. Existing MPE methods rely on the不可约性irreducibility可识别性的假设或其变体。在本文中，我们提出了基于给定类标签的条件独立性（CI）的新颖假设，即使在不可约性不成立的情况下也能确保可识别性。我们在这些假设下开发了矩估计方法并分析了它们的渐近性质。此外，我们提出了弱监督的内核测试来验证 CI 假设，这些假设在因果发现和公平性评估等应用中具有独立的意义。根据经验，我们证明了与现有方法相比，我们的估计器的性能得到了改进，并且我们的测试成功地控制了 I 类和 II 类错误。assumption or its variant for identifiability. In this paper, we propose novel assumptions based on conditional independence (CI) given the class label, which ensure identifiability even when irreducibility does not hold. We develop method of moments estimators under these assumptions and analyze their asymptotic properties. Furthermore, we present weakly-supervised kernel tests to validate the CI assumptions, which are of independent interest in applications such as causal discovery and fairness evaluation. Empirically, we demonstrate the improved performance of our estimators compared with existing methods and that our tests successfully control both type I and type II errors.

1 简介INTRODUCTION

混合比例估计（MPE）是估计未标记数据中基础类分布的混合比例的问题。这项工作解决了广义 MPE 设置（未标记-未标记或 UU 设置），其中我们从两个不同的混合分布中获得样本，Mixture Proportion Estimation (MPE) is the problem of estimating the mixture proportions of underlying class distributions in unlabeled data. This work addresses a generalized MPE setting (Unlabeled-Unlabeled or UU setting) where we are given samples from two distinct mixture distributions,U=θ​P+(1−θ)​NU=\theta P+(1-\theta)N和andU′=θ′​P+(1−θ′)​NU^{\prime}=\theta^{\prime}P+(1-\theta^{\prime})N。在这里，. Here,PP和andNN分别表示正类和负类概率分布，目标是估计未知类先验represent the positive and negative class probability distributions, respectively, and the objective is to estimate the unknown class priors(θ,θ′)(\theta,\theta^{\prime})。该公式是标准 MPE 设置（正未标记或 PU 设置）的严格概括，它假设可以访问. This formulation is a strict generalization of the standard MPE setting (Positive-Unlabeled or PU setting), which assumes access toPP，对应于以下情况, corresponding to the case whereθ=1\theta=1.

MPE 是各种机器学习任务的关键组成部分。例如，弱监督学习，例如正向无标记学习MPE is a critical component in various machine learning tasks. For instance, weakly-supervised learning such as positive-unlabeled learning(Elkan and Noto, 2008; du Plessis et al., 2014; Kiryo et al., 2017),无标记-无标记学习, unlabeled-unlabeled learning(Lu et al., 2019, 2021)，并从成对相似性中学习, and learning from pairwise similarity(Bao et al., 2018)需要已知的混合比例来训练分类器。 MPE 的其他应用包括使用标签噪声进行学习require known mixture proportions to train classifiers. Other applications of MPE include learning with label noise(Natarajan et al., 2013; Scott et al., 2013; Liu and Tao, 2016)、异常检测, anomaly detection(Sanderson and Scott, 2014)，以及开放集标签移位下的域适应, and domain adaptation under open set label shift(Garg et al., 2022).

对分布没有任何假设Without any assumptions on the distributionsPP和andNN, (θ,θ′)(\theta,\theta^{\prime})无法识别。为了解决这个问题，are not identifiable. To address this,Blanchard et al. (2010)引入了不可约性假设，该假设假设introduced the irreducibility assumption, which posits thatNN是不可约的is irreducible with respect toPP。直观上，这意味着负分布不能表示为包含正分布的混合。在 UU 设置中，相反：. Intuitively, this means that the negative distribution cannot be expressed as a mixture containing the positive distribution. In the UU setting, the converse: irreducibility ofPP关于with respect toNN也需要可识别性is also required for identifiability(Scott, 2015)。 迄今为止，大多数现有的 MPE 算法. To date, most of the existing MPE algorithms(Scott, 2015; Scott et al., 2013; Jain et al., 2016; Ramaswamy et al., 2016; Ivanov, 2020; Bekker and Davis, 2020)是在不可约性假设或更严格的条件下开发的，例如锚集假设have been developed under the irreducibility assumption or stricter conditions, such as the anchor set assumption(Ramaswamy et al., 2016).

然而，正如所讨论的，在实际应用中可能会违反不可约性假设However, the irreducibility assumption can be violated in practical applications as discussed byZhu et al. (2023)。据我们所知，. To the best of our knowledge,Yao et al. (2022)和andZhu et al. (2023)是唯一尝试超越不可约性的 MPE 的现有作品，但它们仍然有局限性。重组方法为are the only existing works that have attempted MPE beyond irreducibility, while they still have limitations. The regrouping method ofYao et al. (2022)可以减轻估计偏差，但在统计上不一致。can mitigate estimation bias, but is not statistically consistent.Zhu et al. (2023)导出了比不可约性更一般的条件，需要以下的本质上界derived a more general condition than irreducibility that requires the essential supremum ofP​(Y|X=x)P(Y|X=x)，这在实践中通常是不可用的。, which is usually unavailable in practice.

这项工作研究了替代假设并提出了 MPE 的新可识别性结果。我们的假设基于底层数据结构：给定类标签的条件独立性。 CI 假设在各个机器学习领域被广泛采用。例如，在文本分类和垃圾邮件过滤中This work investigates alternative assumptions and presents new identifiability results for MPE. Our assumptions are based on the underlying data structure: conditional independence given class label. The CI assumption is widely adopted across various machine learning domains. For instance, in text classification and spam filtering(Jurafsky and Martin, 2024)，通常假设特征在给定标签的情况下是独立的。同样，多视图学习范式，包括协同训练, features are often assumed to be independent given the label. Similarly, multi-view learning paradigms, including co-training(Blum and Mitchell, 1998)和无监督学习and unsupervised-learning(Song et al., 2014; Steinhardt and Liang, 2016; Anandkumar et al., 2014)，经常利用功能集之间的条件独立性。应用程序包括网页分类, frequently leverage conditional independence between feature sets. The applications include web page categorization(Blum and Mitchell, 1998), 文本图像分类, text-image categorization(Giesen et al., 2021)和生物数据，例如流式细胞术and biological data such as flow cytometry(Song et al., 2014)。我们考虑两个结构假设，条件独立性（CI）和多元条件独立性（MCI），在此基础上我们开发了矩估计器方法。. We consider two structural assumptions, conditional independence (CI) and multivariate conditional independence (MCI), on which we develop the method of moments estimators.

我们还建立了内核测试方法，仅根据观察到的数据来验证 CI 假设We also establish kernel test methods to verify the CI assumptions from only observed data fromUU和andU′U^{\prime}（弱监督设置）。我们的测试是从非参数内核测试（例如 HSIC）发展而来(weakly-supervised setting). Our tests are developed from non-parametric kernel tests such as HSIC(Gretton et al., 2007)和基于内核的条件独立测试and Kernel-based Conditional Independence test(Zhang et al., 2011)。我们展示了温和条件下的测试一致性。相比之下，现有的 MPE 假设（例如不可约性）通常难以验证，目前尚不存在此类研究。我们的测试不仅在 MPE 中具有潜在的应用，而且在公平性评估中也有潜在的应用. We show the test consistency under mild conditions. In contrast, existing MPE assumptions, such as irreducibility, are generally difficult to verify, and no such studies currently exist. Our tests have potential applications not only in MPE, but also in fairness evaluation(Mehrabi et al., 2021)和因果发现and causal discovery(Gordon et al., 2023).

我们的贡献总结如下。Our contributions are summarized as follows.

    我们在特定于类的 CI（给定类标签的两个特征的独立性）和 MCI（给定类标签和附加特征的两个特征的独立性）假设下提出了 MPE 的矩估计方法。我们展示了估计量的渐近正态性。We propose method of moments estimators for MPE, under class-specific CI (independence of two features given the class label) and MCI (independence of two features given the class label and additional features) assumptions. We show the asymptotic normality of estimators.

We derive the asymptotic distributions of the proposed test statistics underH0H_{0}并提出伽玛近似方法。and propose gamma approximation methods.

5 弱监督环境下的 CI 和 MCI 测试CI AND MCI TEST UNDER WEAKLY-SUPERVISED SETTING

在本节中，我们介绍统计测试方法，仅使用未标记的数据来测试 CI 和 MCI 假设。这些测试使我们能够验证我们提出的 MPE 方法的适用性。除了这个主要目标之外，这些测试还有更广泛的应用，包括因果发现和公平性评估。在因果发现中，需要条件独立性测试来推断基础数据的因果图In this section, we introduce statistical testing methods to test the CI and MCI assumptions using only unlabeled data. These tests allow us to verify the applicability of our proposed MPE method. Beyond this primary objective, these tests have broader applications, including causal discovery and fairness evaluation. In causal discovery, conditional independence tests are required to infer the causal graph of the underlying data(Peters et al., 2017)。在公平性评估中，确定分类器的输出或表示是否是至关重要的. In fairness evaluation, it is crucial to determine whether a classifier’s output or representationf​(X)f(X)独立于受保护的变量is independent of a protected variableZZ（例如种族或性别）(e.g., race or sex) givenYY.

我们提出的测试也可以被构建为 CI 测试，在最近的工作中具有单个未观察到的混杂因素Our proposed tests can also be framed as a CI test with a single unobserved confounder in the context of recent work(Gordon et al., 2023; Mazaheri et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2024)。然而，现有方法存在局限性；例如，方法. However, existing methods have limitations; for instance, the methods ofGordon et al. (2023)和andMazaheri et al. (2023)仅限于离散变量。虽然测试通过are restricted to discrete variables. While the test byLiu et al. (2024)可以通过引入索引变量来表示样本的来源（could be adopted by introducing an index variable to denote a sample’s origin (UU or U′U^{\prime}），其应用依赖于积分方程的特定条件。), its application relies on a specific condition of integral equation.

在以下小节中，我们首先提出一种假设真实混合比例已知的测试方法。由于比例事先未知，因此该设置并不能直接验证假设In the following subsections, we first present a testing method that assumes the true mixture proportions are known. Since the proportions are unknown in advance, this setting does not directly verify Assumptions1和and2对于 MPE。尽管如此，该方法对于上述其他应用仍然有价值。随后，我们介绍了一种没有真实混合比例的测试方法。for MPE. Nevertheless, the method remains valuable for the other applications mentioned above. Subsequently, we introduce a testing method without the true mixture proportions.

6 实验EXPERIMENTS

6.1 混合物比例估计Mixture Proportion Estimation

我们使用来自 UCI 机器学习存储库的合成数据和基准数据集来实现 MPE 方法。估计的We implement our MPE methods with synthetic data and benchmark datasets taken from the UCI machine learning repository. The estimatedα±\alpha_{\pm}通过我们的方法转换为by our methods are converted to(θ^,θ^′)=(1−α^−α^+−α^−,−α^−α^+−α^−)(\hat{\theta},\hat{\theta}^{\prime})=(\frac{1-\hat{\alpha}_{-}}{\hat{\alpha}_{+}-\hat{\alpha}_{-}},\frac{-\hat{\alpha}_{-}}{\hat{\alpha}_{+}-\hat{\alpha}_{-}})与现有 MPE 方法进行比较。for comparison with existing MPE methods.

具有合成数据的 CI MPECI MPE with synthetic data为了评估我们的方法，我们利用高斯数据和来自 UCI 机器学习存储库的三个数据集。我们将我们的 CI MPE 方法与三种现有的 MPE 算法进行比较：DEDPULTo evaluate our method, we utilize Gaussian data and three datasets from the UCI machine learning repository. We compare our CI MPE method with three existing MPE algorithms: DEDPUL(Ivanov, 2020), EN (Elkan and Noto, 2008)和公里2and KM2(Ramaswamy et al., 2016)是在不可约性假设或其变体下开发的。由于这些基线方法是针对阳性和未标记数据而设计的，因此我们设置that are developed under the irreducibility assumption or its variant. Since these baseline methods are designed for positive and unlabeled data, we setθ=1\theta=1并只专注于估计and focused on estimating onlyθ′\theta^{\prime}.

每个类的高斯数据是从二维高斯分布生成的：Gaussian data for each class is generated from a two-dimensional Gaussian distribution:X1∼𝒩​(Y,1),X2∼𝒩​(Y,1)X_{1}\sim\mathcal{N}(Y,1),X_{2}\sim\mathcal{N}(Y,1)。 对于 UCI 数据集，我们选择 Shuttle、Wine 和 Dry Bean 数据集。附录中详细介绍了每个数据集指定为正类和负类的具体类别. For UCI datasets, we choose Shuttle, Wine and Dry Bean datasets. The specific classes assigned as positive and negative for each dataset are detailed in AppendixD.2.1。本实验的主要目标是验证我们的方法，当 CI 假设（假设. 7 结论与讨论CONCLUSIONS AND DISCUSSIONS

这项工作引入了混合比例估计 (MPE) 的新颖可识别条件：特定类别的条件独立性 (CI) 和多元条件独立性 (MCI) 假设。基于这些条件，我们提出了矩估计方法并建立了它们的理论性质。This work introduces novel identifiability conditions for mixture proportion estimation (MPE): the class-specific Conditional Independence (CI) and Multivariate Conditional Independence (MCI) assumptions. Based on these conditions, we propose method of moments estimators and establish their theoretical properties.

另一个贡献是开发了基于弱监督内核的统计测试（WsKCI 和 WsKMCI），仅使用未标记的数据来验证这些 CI 和 MCI 假设。这些测试具有潜在的应用，例如因果发现和公平性评估。我们凭经验证明了所提出的 MPE 估计量和统计检验的有效性。Another contribution is the development of weakly-supervised kernel-based statistical tests (WsKCI and WsKMCI) that validate these CI and MCI assumptions using only unlabeled data. These tests have potential applications such as causal discovery and fairness assessment. We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed MPE estimators and statistical tests.

这项研究提出了未来研究的几个方向。首先，我们的 MPE 方法的性能取决于函数的选择Several directions for future research arise from this study. First, the performance of our MPE methods depends on the choice of functionsg1g_{1}和andg2g_{2}。研究如何选择. Investigating how to chooseg1g_{1}和andg2g_{2}较小的估计方差是一个重要的方向。其次，对高维数据进行统计测试具有挑战性，因为候选 CI 和 MCI 对的数量可能会变得很大，从而导致多重测试问题。开发一种方法来有效地找到高维数据中满足 MPE 假设的对留待未来的工作。第三个方向是将我们的测试统计量用作公平和域不变表示学习的正则化器，类似于for the smaller estimation variance is an important direction. Second, conducting our statistical tests on high-dimensional data is challenging, as the number of candidate CI and MCI pairs can become large, which causes a multiple testing problem. Developing a method to efficiently find pairs that satisfy the MPE assumptions in high-dimensional data is left for future work. A third direction is to apply our test statistic as a regularizer for fair and domain-invariant representation learning, similarly toPogodin et al. (2023).

D.2 实验细节Experimental details

D.2.1 具有合成数据的 CI MPECI MPE with synthetic data

对于 UCI 数据集，正类和负类的分配如表所示For the UCI datasets, the positive and negative classes were assigned as shown in Table6。我们将混合比例的搜索范围设置为. We set the search range for the mixture proportion to beIα+=ℝ+I_{\alpha^{+}}=\mathbb{R}_{+}.

D.2.2 具有真实世界数据的 CI MPECI MPE with real-world data

我们使用了 UCI 存储库中的两个数据集：威斯康星州乳腺癌数据集和 Dry Bean 数据集。对于每个数据集，我们选择正类和负类并实施实验，切换类。程序如下：We used two datasets from the UCI repository: the Breast Cancer Wisconsin and Dry Bean datasets. For each dataset, we chose positive and negative classes and implemented the experiments, switching the classes. The procedure was as follows:

  1. 1.

    我们首先选择一组候选特征We first selected a candidate set of featuresXiX_{i}具有歧视性的、令人满意的that were discriminative, satisfying|E[Xi∣Y=1]−E[Xi∣Y=−1]|/V​[Xi∣Y=1]>0.5\left|E\left[X_{i}\mid Y=1\right]-E\left[X_{i}\mid Y=-1\right]\right|/\sqrt{V\left[X_{i}\mid Y=1\right]}>0.5，因为显着的平均差对于有效的 MPE 至关重要。, since a significant mean difference is essential for the efficient MPE.

  2. 2.

    然后，我们对该候选集中的所有特征对应用 HSIC 测试，以识别那些满足 CI 条件的特征，显着性水平为 0.05。We then applied the HSIC test to all pairs of features from this candidate set to identify those satisfying the CI condition, with a significance level 0.05.

  3. 3.

    对于每个检测到的 CI 特征对，我们运行 CI MPE 方法 10 次。For each detected CI feature pair, we ran our CI MPE method 10 times.

对于 MPE 任务，我们设置For the MPE task, we setn=n′=2000n=n^{\prime}=2000并使用了带有类的正未标记（PU）设置and used a Positive-Unlabeled (PU) setting with classpriors⁡(θ,θ′)=(1,0.5)\operatorname{priors}\left(\theta,\theta^{\prime}\right)=(1,0.5).

D.3.2 在没有真实混合比例的情况下研究 MCI 测试中的低功效Investigation of low power in the MCI test without true mixture proportions

为了调查测试功效低的原因，我们将我们的方法与使用真实零分布的测试（通过 1000 次试验进行模拟）进行了比较。我们使用与节中相同的设置To investigate the cause of the low test power, we compared our method to a test using the true null distribution (simulated with 1000 trials). We used the same setup as in Section6.2 (H0:σ12=0H_{0}:\sigma_{12}=0, H1:σ12=0.2H_{1}:\sigma_{12}=0.2, n=n′=1000n=n^{\prime}=1000）。表). Table9总结了结果。summarizes the results.

如表所示As shown in Table9，即使采用真实的零分布，理想的测试功效仍然很低 (0.293)。这表明真实零分布和替代分布之间的分离不佳导致小样本中的功效较低。, even with the true null distribution, the ideal test power remains low (0.293). This indicates that the poor separation between the true null and alternative distributions causes the low power in small samples.
